schema.title: Bookkeeping setup
schema.description: Tells the bookkeeping automations how your practice works. You can submit it again at any time to change the answers.

questions.label: How do you use this workspace?
options: Practice: we keep the books for many client businesses
In-house: we keep our own books

questions.label: Who reviews bills before they're approved? (default for every client)
Who gets bills the AI couldn't process? (leave blank to use the reviewer)
Who gets the weekly accounts payable digest? (leave blank to use the reviewer)
After a bill is reviewed, it should be in Xero as…
Bills from a known supplier below this amount may skip review when the AI is confident (0 = always review)
Bills above this amount need the client's approval (leave blank for never; each client can override)
Outlook mailbox that receives bills (the Email intake (Outlook) automation reads its owner's inbox)
Gmail mailbox that receives bills (the Email intake (Gmail) automation reads its owner's inbox)
